description: Recommend the best matching templates for any use case. Describe what you need and the system auto-detects the category and ranks templates by relevance. Return the recommendations so the user can pick a template from the visual gallery; do not call `generate` in the same turn unless the user explicitly names a template_id or asks you to skip selection.

category.description: Optional category override. Auto-detected from use_case if not provided.
category.title: Category

needs.description: Optional explicit needs such as favicon, navbar, og-image
needs.title: Needs

subcategory.description: Optional subcategory constraint such as lettermark or app_icon
subcategory.title: Subcategory

use_case.description: Describe what you need the template for (e.g. 'Instagram post for a restaurant daily special', 'logo for a fitness brand')
use_case.title: Use Case

name: recommend_template
title: Recommend a template
